attributes.title: ADHA27 Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
ADHA27, the annual conference of the American Dental Hygienists' Association, is set for October 15 to 17, 2027 in Phoenix, Arizona. The national association organizes it for dental hygienists, and it combines continuing education with networking and association events.

Registration had not opened when we checked. ADHA offers a "Phoenix First" sign-up that sends early news and priority access when registration opens. The venue, fees and CE hours have not been announced yet.

Hygienists who need hours before a fall 2027 license renewal should watch for the program release, since state boards differ on how many live hours they accept.
